input.command: python3 -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; out=Path("out"); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True); q="SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM crash_date)::INT AS dow, COUNT(*) AS crashes FROM read_parquet(\"data/crashes.parquet\") WHERE crash_date >= DATE \'2013-01-01\' AND crash_date < DATE \'2026-01-01\' GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow"; df=duckdb.sql(q).df(); names={1:"Monday",2:"Tuesday",3:"Wednesday",4:"Thursday",5:"Friday",6:"Saturday",7:"Sunday"}; df["day_of_week"]=df["dow"].map(names); df["share_percent"]=df["crashes"] / df["crashes"].sum() * 100; df=df[["day_of_week","crashes","share_percent"]]; df.to_csv(out/"values.csv",index=False,float_format="%.2f"); plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); bars=plt.bar(df["day_of_week"],df["crashes"],color=["#4C78A8"]*5+["#F58518"]*2); plt.title("NYC Police-Reported Motor Vehicle Crashes by Day of Week\n2013–2025"); plt.ylabel("Crashes"); plt.xlabel("Day of week"); plt.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); plt.gca().yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x,p:f"{x/1000:.0f}k")); plt.bar_label(bars,labels=[f"{v/1000:.0f}k" for v in df["crashes"]],padding=3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/"initial.png",dpi=180,bbox_inches="tight"); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("Total:",int(df["crashes"].sum()))'
